notes: Source: supplied Team Profile PDF, Sonar lean canvas dated 15 November 2026. Proposed prices: Free R0, Creator R149, Studio R499, Agency R1499 per month. Free: local editing, compatible BYOK, basic exports and limited hosted trials. Exact allowances must follow task benchmarks; do not infer source-minute limits. Proposed commission is 7% on qualifying digital sales/licences with processing separately disclosed. Institutions and managed services are additional revenue possibilities, not existing contracts. Fixed monthly budget R85000 = engineering/founder compensation R50000 + part-time design/QA/content R12000 + community/support R6000 + infrastructure R5000 + marketing R8000 + legal/admin/security R4000. Hosted compute modelling budgets R25/R110/R390 do not include every variable cost. 55 Creator subscribers × R149 = R8195 MRR; less compute budget R1375 = R6820 before other variable costs. This does not cover R85000 fixed costs. Creator-only lower-bound break-even ignoring every other variable cost = ceil(85000/(149-25)) = 686. Real break-even will be higher and depends on plan mix, processing costs, support, churn, acquisition and VAT. Do not claim measured profitability. Earlier R199/R12000 scenario is superseded.

notes: Aligned with supplied canvas. Six-month pilot targets: 800 registered; 300 first usable exports; 55 paid subscriptions; 30% activated creators return within 30 days; at least 300 monthly exports; 20 structured interviews; five repeat-using studio customers. These are targets, not claims of results. Adoption channels: demonstrations with studios/editors/creator communities, tutorials, university/creative-hub workshops, referrals and later partnerships. First export should demonstrate value before upsell. Build sequence: (1) identity, assets, upload/resume, edit/clip, captions/review/export; (2) rights declarations, approved publishing and connected metrics; (3) licensing/storefront commerce, wider dubbing and hybrid local processing after technical evaluation. Use mature modules but verify licences and exact deployments. Local-first lower-spec compatibility is an aspiration requiring hardware benchmarks; cloud fallback is needed. Model/provider names in the canvas are adapters to evaluate, not confirmed integrations. Do not implement all providers in the MVP. The R85000 monthly budget is operating spend, not a development quotation.
